description: Type the 409 `save_in_progress` that saved-snapshot writes get while a save under the same name is still running. The spec documents it on POST /saved-snapshots and DELETE /saved-snapshots/{name}; observed live 2026-11-12 on deleteSavedSnapshot: "\"<name>\" is still saving. Wait for it to finish before removing it."

traits.smithy.api#documentation: A save under this snapshot name is still running (`save_in_progress`). Wait for getSavedSnapshot to settle at `ready` or `failed`, then retry.
